headline: Variance granted for garage at 3 Foxglove Street; front porch request continued
summary: James and Sandra Long are restoring a house at 3 Foxglove Street after years of neglect and want a second garage and a farmer's porch. The garage would extend 7 ft 6 in into the 15-ft side setback and 28 ft 10 in into the 40-ft front setback. The porch request, 36 ft 6 in into the 40-ft front setback, was continued, and the owners will return with revised plans on December 16th. A request for a 5-ft fence in the front setback at 207 High Range Road was also denied.
decisions: Denied a 5-ft fence in the 40-ft front setback at 207 High Range Road.
Granted a variance for a garage 7 ft 6 in into the 15-ft side setback at 3 Foxglove Street.
Approved a variance for a garage 28 ft 10 in into the 40-ft front setback at 3 Foxglove Street.
Continued the front porch request at 3 Foxglove Street to a later meeting.
discussion: 207 High Range Road fence: Members debated whether the sloped back yard and the lack of a back door set the lot apart from others nearby. Speakers said a 4-ft fence would not keep the large dogs in, and the code limit is 4 ft.

Foxglove Street garage: Members said the lot is narrow and long and sits next to the town senior center's parking lot. The town was on the list of abutters notified, and the owners said they had spoken with the senior center.
Foxglove Street porch depth: Members discussed reducing the porch from 6 ft deep to 4 ft, and whether steps would extend it further. The owners agreed to return with revised plans.
